---
title: Julia SVG Magic Move Demo
format: revealjs
engine: julia
revealjs-plugins:
  - magic-move
---

<!--
See the Part A (Julia) write-up from the JS/Julia compatibility investigation
for the full picture. Summary: CairoMakie's SVG output uses the same two
patterns magic-move.js was built around for R (grid/ggplot2) --- point
markers as filled Bezier <path>s with absolute coordinates baked into `d`,
and axis/tick text as <g fill="..."><use .../></g> groups --- so it morphs
correctly. Plots.jl's default GR backend renders point markers as literal
<circle>s (also compatible) but bakes axis tick numerals into individual
glyph <path>s sharing the same clip-path as the data markers; when the
axis range changes between two slides those numeral shapes can get
accidentally paired up by matchSvgPaths's clip+fill heuristic, so this demo
avoids that entirely by fixing identical axis limits/ticks across each
slide pair. Gadfly was tested and excluded: Compose.jl (Gadfly's rendering
backend) positions every mark via an ancestor `<g transform="translate(x,y)">`
wrapper and leaves the mark's own geometry attributes at (0,0), which
magic-move.js's attribute-based parsers never look at, so nothing animates.
-->

## CairoMakie Points - Low {.magic-move}

```{julia}
#| label: "makie-low"
#| fig-format: svg
using CairoMakie
CairoMakie.activate!(type = "svg")
f = Figure(size = (700, 500))
ax = Axis(f[1, 1], limits = (0, 4, 0, 4))
scatter!(ax, [1, 2, 3], [1, 2, 1], markersize = 30, color = :steelblue)
f
```

## CairoMakie Points - High {.magic-move}

```{julia}
#| label: "makie-high"
#| fig-format: svg
using CairoMakie
CairoMakie.activate!(type = "svg")
f = Figure(size = (700, 500))
ax = Axis(f[1, 1], limits = (0, 4, 0, 4))
scatter!(ax, [1, 2, 3], [2, 3, 2], markersize = 30, color = :steelblue)
f
```

## Break

## GR (Plots.jl) Points - Left {.magic-move}

```{julia}
#| label: "gr-left"
#| fig-format: svg
import Plots
Plots.gr(fmt = :svg)
Plots.scatter([1, 2, 3], [1, 2, 1], xlims = (0, 4), ylims = (0, 4),
  xticks = 0:4, yticks = 0:4, markersize = 12, label = "", legend = false)
```

## GR (Plots.jl) Points - Right {.magic-move}

```{julia}
#| label: "gr-right"
#| fig-format: svg
import Plots
Plots.gr(fmt = :svg)
Plots.scatter([2, 3, 4], [3, 4, 3], xlims = (0, 4), ylims = (0, 4),
  xticks = 0:4, yticks = 0:4, markersize = 12, label = "", legend = false)
```
